# tests/fixtures/packs/toy: the toy pack (GEN-21)

A whole pack in the format of docs/AI-STACK.md §6, used by the tests (copied outside the repository and made a git
repository there) and by the preview: a Claude Code plugin manifest, two agents, a skill, MCP servers in `.mcp.json`
(one on a host off any egress list), `stack.yaml` (harness, model, grants), a job kind of the worker protocol, two
templates and an exam set with known outcomes. Generic on purpose: no real system's names.
